item.title: Rural Data Centers Are in for a Big Federal Tax Break
item.description: Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, data center projects in rural areas could be eligible for major tax benefits starting next year. Some hyperscalers do not seem eager to take the free cash.

item.title: The Nvidia Shield TV Is 7 Years Old. It Just Got a $100 Price Hike
item.description: The price of anything with memory is skyrocketing thanks to AI. Aging streaming devices are no exception.

item.title: Muse Creates Detailed Profiles of All Your Friends and Family
item.description: Millions have downloaded Meta’s AI agent Muse. But getting it to do your bidding comes with privacy costs.

item.title: These AI Experts Want to Do High-Stakes Research Out in the Open
item.description: Many frontier labs keep their risky research locked away. Trillium Labs wants to show off its work when it comes to self-improvement and model behavior.

item.title: Trump’s Crazy AI Rebrand Was a Loyalty Test for Tech Execs—and It Worked
item.description: For years these billionaires gushed obsessively about AI. But they meekly went along when Trump canceled the term.

item.title: A Flaw in ChatGPT’s Mac App Could Have Let Hackers Grab Sensitive Data
item.description: While the focus has been on AI agents’ hacking capabilities, a recently patched vulnerability in a ChatGPT app shows that AI software is itself an inviting—and vulnerable—target.

item.title: AI Is Making a Mess of Nurses’ Schedules. They Say It’s a Safety Issue
item.description: A hospital giant and radiology network turned to Palantir to streamline scheduling, but nurses and other staff say the new software is causing errors, burnout, and frustration.

item.title: Whatever AI Safety Is, It’s Not This
item.description: Asking AI companies to self-regulate is a great way to pretend like you’ve accomplished something.

item.title: Trump’s ‘Morally Binding’ AI ‘Accord,’ the Rise of AI Agents, and Extremists on the Ballot
item.description: This week on “Uncanny Valley,” we discuss the voluntary AI safety agreement tech executives signed, AI agents for normies, and extremist candidates running for office in the US midterms.

item.title: Trump’s AI Safety ‘Accord’ Is a Fancy Pinky-Swear
item.description: Six major AI companies signed a voluntary agreement with the White House this week vowing to implement safeguards. It’s unclear how much that matters.
